description: Carlos Gamboa-Canté and colleagues publish KUKAHPÁN-25 seismic-hazard maps for Central America. Zenodo lists an openly accessible ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The project combined a homogenised earthquake catalogue covering 1520–2020 with regional rupture zoning, scaling relations and ground-motion models informed by data from El Salvador and Costa Rica. The maps can provide regional intensity context for earthquake exposure scenarios involving roads, power assets and buildings. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Central American map release. The landing page does not state the internal GIS format, grid resolution or exceedance levels, so quantitative use requires checking the archive and accompanying studies. The maps are model outputs, not observed shaking for a particular event. No archive was downloaded, and map completeness or calibration was not independently checked.
